purpose: Make the prayer room a persistent architectural background that supports stable, readable information on every page.
changes: Architecture sits outside the reading container and remains behind the guide; a restrained camera shift responds to scrolling and map use.
Content stays in normal flow with a wider consistent reading column, aligned floating surfaces and sticky guide tabs.
Door and light controls have their own accessible reading-area bar; destination views and original artwork remain intact.
One complete light/dark semantic palette and explicit local navy-board colors fix inherited text and control contrast.
Three primary navigation destinations use a coherent rail, larger emblem wrappers and selected states; preferences and visitor tools remain grouped in the native menu.
Background motion respects reduced motion, data saving, existing pause control and page visibility; homepage cycle hover scope is limited to destination controls.
preserved: All place records, countries, sources, dates and translations
All guide, arrival and destination-console text and links in 24 representative localized routes
Search, filters, map/list modes, saved places, reception tools and doorway scenes
Original photographic/artwork assets and credits; prayer mat faces solid wall
limitations: Existing browser URL policy block prevented rendered desktop/mobile visual checks. No alternative browser or rendering workaround was used. Responsive layout and RTL were reviewed in source and offline DOM; this does not establish pixel-perfect rendering.

Pinterest search was attempted but usable results were limited and its linked designer account returned 403. No Pinterest imagery was copied. Primary wayfinding references and Hamza pages informed refinement.
deployment: Only Ahmed’s authorized a7mad7amdoun/aroomtopray-preview GitHub Pages site. Hamza production remains untouched; submissions stay disabled. The 11 unrelated pending map files remain outside this release.
buildCommand: PUBLIC_REVIEW_PREVIEW=true PUBLIC_PREVIEW_BASE=/aroomtopray-preview pnpm build, followed by site/scripts/prepare-github-preview.mjs
